archetypes.name: dyn-bash32-grep
archetypes.rationale: The new awk rule must catch only unsafe Bash 3.2 grep condition shapes without false positives.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the lint-bash32 awk regex and fixtures for anchoring accuracy. Confirm it catches if command grep, elif command grep, negated forms, and grep-family variants while allowing subshell and piped forms. Pay attention to POSIX awk compatibility and whether the linter can flag its own fixture text unexpectedly. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
